name: Gastroenterology scopes
summary: How expats arrange gastroscopy and colonoscopy in Singapore — referral paths, bowel-prep timing, sedation choices, and insurance pre-auth realities.
body:
Gastroenterologists perform diagnostic and screening scopes when symptoms, age, or family history justify them. Bowel prep quality decides colonoscopy usefulness; sedation and recovery windows shape work calendars.

## Decision points
- GP referral vs direct private booking
- Gastroscopy, colonoscopy, or both in one session
- Sedation vs deeper anaesthesia options
- Bowel-prep timing around flights and meetings
- Panel hospital vs private centre pre-auth

Bring prior endoscopy reports if you have them.

## How to choose
Prefer centres that explain prep clearly and give a reachable nurse line overnight. Ask who calls with histology results and typical turnaround. Confirm what is included in package quotes (histology, polyps, recovery bay).

## Practical tip
Block the afternoon after colonoscopy even if you “feel fine.” Sedation plus prep fatigue makes heroic inbox clearing a bad idea.
whenToEngage: Symptoms or screening need gastroscopy / colonoscopy
Bowel-prep timing around work or travel
Sedation pathway and recovery window unclear
